projects.title: PRYMEKIDS
projects.description: Building a visual language for young learners
projects.overview: PrymeKids needed its brand ideas turned into content kids and parents would actually stop and look at — starting from dense brochure material that needed a friendlier, more visual translation.
projects.strategy: I rebuilt the brochure content as a system of infographics, then extended that system into two ongoing content formats so the brand had a consistent voice across posts and stories, not just one-off graphics.

projects.title: XEL
projects.description: Building an agent-native university, not a software tool.
projects.overview: Xel is an agent-native healthcare university whose visual identity leverages Inter typography, a primary #2563EB blue palette, and a grid-constructed logo mark to convey systematic trust and scale.
projects.strategy: My approach applies strict geometric grid alignment, high-contrast visual hierarchy, and task-driven layout structures to reflect Xel's autonomous AI coordination while maintaining brand integrity across all touchpoints.

projects.title: THE POTTER'S PORCH INTERNATIONAL CHURCHES
projects.description: Curating Storytelling Visuals for the religious organization
projects.overview: TPPIC — Lagos needed consistency in their designs, linking deigns to each other so they can feel like one by maintaining font choice, colour palette and other resources that will contribute to the uniformity of the design.
projects.strategy: I studied their designs and formulate the matching colour palette to their previous designs, and i also gathered resources that complement the ones on ground, this which helped me maintain the consistency they sought.
